headline: The attract demo fights for its life now
lede: EMBERWOOD's proof-route bot stopped walking through monsters and started fighting them the way the vale teaches: sidestep the charge, punish the rest, never test the husk's front.

notes.text: Species-aware hit-and-run in the attract bot: tuskroot telegraphs are sidestepped on the perpendicular with zero damage, the 55-frame rest gets punished, husks fall to steep-diagonal flank bites (0 clanks), the Maw takes two strikes per thorn window then stands off, and the Wyrm eats align-draw-loose-retreat volleys before steel ever touches the cloak.

A blacklisted husk tail livelocked the route for 13k ticks mid-session; BFS-reachability gating, one honest try per monster, and a panic-break sprint now keep the demo alive — win tick 11233, identical hash every seed.
emberwoodcheck grew 7 duel gates (135 total) and proved it can fail: disabling the rest-window punish turns tuskroot's gate red; restored, green.
Filed #873: should SSX phones get a physical analogue stick or keep arcade taps? Default (keep taps) takes it at the deadline.
